subject: general
question:
A, B, C, D, E and F live on six different floors of the same building. The lowermost floor in the building is numbered 1, the floor above it, number 2 and so on till the topmost floor is numbered 6.

Only one person lives below E. A does not live on the topmost floor. Only three people live between A and C. C lives below A. D lives immediately above B. Who lives immediately above A?
solution:
